title: Apply for an assistance animal permit
summary: Find out about the requirements and process for getting a permit or accreditation for your assistance animal to travel on public transport in NSW.
intro:
If you want your assistance animal to accompany you on public transport in NSW, you need to have either a permit from Transport for NSW or accreditation from an organisation endorsed by Transport for NSW. Interstate accreditation must be recognised by Transport for NSW.

Valid accreditation allows your animal to ride with you, free of charge, on trains, buses, ferries, light rail, taxis, private buses and private ferry services.TfNSW permits are free, and valid for 24 months.
